name: Komus
verdict: Komus group, owned by founder Sergey Bobrikov (96% via ООО «ТПГК»). Nothing found.
note: Partner of HC Spartak Moscow. Russian office-supplies group; owned by founder Sergey Bobrikov through ООО «ТПГК» (96%, with 4% held by CFO Gennady Lomasov), per Forbes reported by vc.ru (2020). No human-rights findings against the company or owners identified.
